test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Pushes and pull requests run public GitHub Actions tests across operating systems. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/actions

warnings_justification: TypeScript strict mode and type-aware ESLint rules check source quality. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/tsconfig.json https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/eslint.config.mjs
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint rules are errors and TypeScript rejects errors; compile/lint were rerun when preparing this assessment. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/eslint.config.mjs
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript enables strict, unused-local/parameter, implicit-return and fallthrough checks; ESLint checks unsafe assignments and promises. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/tsconfig.json https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/eslint.config.mjs
crypto_published_justification: Managed downloads use HTTPS and pinned SHA-256 digests through Node.js APIs; the extension does not define a new cryptographic protocol. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/managed-tex.ts
crypto_call_justification: SHA-256 verification calls Node.js crypto.createHash; HTTPS uses the runtime fetch implementation. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/managed-tex.ts
crypto_floss_justification: The download cryptography is implementable using FLOSS Node.js and its cryptographic/TLS libraries. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/managed-tex.ts
crypto_password_storage_justification: The extension has no external-user authentication service or password database. It provides local editing, building and preview. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/README.md
delivery_mitm_justification: Extension delivery uses HTTPS Marketplace/GitHub endpoints. Managed TeX downloads restrict each redirect to approved HTTPS hosts and verify pinned SHA-256. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/managed-tex.ts
delivery_unsigned_justification: Expected SHA-256 digests are embedded in the extension manifests, not retrieved over unsigned HTTP. Download redirects reject HTTP. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/tinytex-manifest.ts https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/src/utils/managed-tex.ts
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL scans JavaScript/TypeScript and Python on pushes/PRs; automatic stable releases require CodeQL success. Type-aware ESLint is also used. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/.github/workflows/auto-stable-release.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL performs security analysis of JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. The df86a3e run passed. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/actions/runs/35817047861
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on master pushes and pull requests. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: fast-check varies TeX/parser inputs and checks properties. Fuzzing is required by automatic stable release gating and is included in release tests. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/test/fuzz/parser.fast-check.test.js https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/.github/workflows/auto-stable-release.yml
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Property-based tests use fc.assert and node:assert/strict while executing generated inputs. https://github.com/thinksyncs/LaTeX-Secure-Workspace/blob/df86a3ebc1c18979fbb14f3542fdd286d3950496/test/fuzz/parser.fast-check.test.js
